description: Takes your supplier list with one row per supplier and yes/no columns for contact named, registered in the portal, master data complete, bank details verified, contract or terms signed, catalogue or prices loaded and test order completed, plus an optional go-live date. Returns a readiness percentage and traffic light per supplier (red: a required item is missing; yellow: only catalogue or test order missing), what is missing most often, and a letter template to the suppliers that are not ready yet. Red overall only when the start is 14 days away or less. To check the switchover of a system itself use check_switchover. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

as_of.description: Optional: reference date YYYY-MM-DD. Default today (Europe/Berlin).

go_live.description: Optional: start date of the switchover or the offer deadline, YYYY-MM-DD.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: One row per supplier: supplier, contact, registered, master_data, bank, contract, catalog, test (yes/no each; columns you leave out are not checked), note. German column names work too (lieferant, kontakt, portal, stammdaten, bankdaten, vertrag, katalog, testbestellung).

name: check_supplier_readiness
title: Supplier readiness: which suppliers are ready for a switchover or a tender, what is missing per supplier, and a letter to the open ones
